title.rendered: Ondo CP assures NYSC of corps members’ safety, stronger partnership

content.rendered:
The Commissioner of Police in Ondo State, Felix Ohagwu, has reaffirmed the command’s commitment to strengthening its partnership with the National Youth Service Corps to ensure the safety and security of corps members serving across the state.

Ohagwu gave the assurance when the Ondo State Coordinator of the NYSC, Mrs Bakare Kuburat, led members of the scheme’s management team on a courtesy visit to the state police headquarters in Akure.

PUNCH Online reports that the visit comes amid renewed calls for stronger collaboration among security agencies to address emerging security threats and guarantee the safety of corps members deployed to various parts of the country.

According to a statement issued on Sunday by the Ondo State Police Public Relations Officer, DSP Abayomi Jimoh, the NYSC coordinator commended the police command for its continued support and security assistance to the scheme.

During the visit, Kuburat expressed appreciation to the commissioner and officers of the command for ensuring the safety of corps members throughout their orientation programmes and service year.

She also advocated deeper collaboration among security agencies to tackle emerging security challenges.

“The Coordinator further called for sustained collaboration among security agencies through stronger inter-agency synergy, enhanced intelligence, information sharing and reinforced institutional cooperation to effectively address emerging security challenges and strengthen public safety”, the statement partly read.

Responding, the police commissioner commended the NYSC for its contributions to national integration and youth development, assuring the delegation of the command’s continued support.

“In his response, CP Felix Ohagwu warmly welcomed the State Coordinator and her team, commending the NYSC for its invaluable contributions to national unity, youth development and nation-building.

“He assured the delegation that the issues and requests presented had been duly noted and reaffirmed the Command’s readiness to continue working closely with the Scheme to guarantee the safety of Corps Members and foster a peaceful and secure environment across Ondo State”, the statement continued.

The statement added that the police commissioner reiterated his commitment to proactive policing and collaboration with relevant stakeholders to sustain peace and security across the state.

“The Commissioner reiterated that the Ondo State Police Command, under his leadership, remains committed to proactive policing, effective collaboration with critical stakeholders, and the strengthening of strategic partnerships aimed at sustaining peace, public safety, and security throughout the State”, the statement added.

The visit was attended by members of the command’s management team and concluded with the presentation of an NYSC magazine to the commissioner by the state coordinator, followed by a group photograph.
